_about: Spec docs that jev-spec-check judges for test coverage. 'spec' is a markdown file; every list item and table row in it is one rule. 'watch' is a regex on edited paths: editing a matching file (or the spec itself) triggers jev-spec-hook.py. 'tests' is a regex that picks test files (the default covers tests/, __tests__/, *.test.*, *.spec.*, test_*.py). Replace the example below with your own.
